verification_notes: An earlier full regression also passed 2031 tests. After tightening false StaleGeneration reply validation and clearing ambiguity for validated Rejected/Cancelled completions, all seven checks were rerun against final source. Only the final rerun is used as source-bound evidence.
limitations: KWAQ/KWAR public Apply DTOs and Transaction are platform-neutral components only. No Linux/Windows public Apply transport, host adapter, CLI command or GUI Apply button is wired yet. Existing Status/Stop and private reload frame formats are unchanged.

Eight new deterministic tests use trusted mock Backend tickets. Two integration tests use actual cold Linux preparation and Engine.activate with a test-only synchronous ticket adapter and synthetic physical events. They do not execute a native worker/ACK channel, input capture, injection, progress receipt or recovery operation.

Backend must exclusively own actual reload request/ACK correlation for exact bytes/base/target. This trust boundary is documented; the generic trait cannot authenticate a process or prove an arbitrary implementer tells the truth. Watcher/external source arbitration and production ACK adapters remain mandatory.

Absolute injected time is checked before and after each backend method; callbacks themselves must be bounded by the platform owner. A public transaction timeout/Drop does not cancel or roll back an actual reload. Pending never renews deadlines; late commit/lost ACK remains potentially applied with no automatic replay.

Final replies are cached historical facts; repeating step on Finished does no new backend IO/clock query and does not renew transport deadlines or establish current active configuration. Native transports and GUI must enforce independent send deadlines and exact document/endpoint request binding.

No native GUI, device, Windows SDK or new native IPC gate was run for this protocol-only slice. Eight existing Unix IPC tests remain default-ignored and were not rerun. Prior Windows approval quota rejection was not retried. Full migration/GUI/native hardware/Wayland/drivers/packaging remains unfinished.
